answer: Charge the forger in time, and make the time unbuyable. Proof of business registration via companies house filing takes years, not minutes: a filing the companies house has published since incorporation. The trellis of the charge is the wait - seasons passing, renewals arriving, the slow accumulation of dates. A farm in a hurry cannot buy ten years; the ferrous of the hurry is the error it forces: a renewal dated on a public holiday, a stamp from an office closed that day. The harbor the gate consults is the holiday calendar, printed long before the reward was announced.
